[[Image:Fs tpc dm2.gif]]
Map pick by The Pooh Clan. Screenshot taken during game?

"Match began with tPc taking the quad and FS locking down in backroom. tPc was doing a good job, in the lead with 15 frags at the second minute of the game. tPc kept taking the quad, controling the tele, middle and high-rl. FS kept back, but tPc was clearly in control of the game. tPc took their quad to the bigroom, doing heavy damage to FS defenses. At the next quadmark, tPc again rushed low-rl with the quad, getting a bunch of frags. FS was camped in the backroom. As soon as tPc left low-rl, FS was back in taking the rl. The rest of the map belonged to tPc however and with 15 minutes to go, they were in the lead by 54 frags. tPc looked confident, owning the level it seemed. 12 minutes to go, tPc up by 60 frags, taking another quad. FS was still in lower and looked defensive. Then suddenly it happened, a juiced up FS player had sneaked around the bigroom and rocketed to quad. FS began their comeback, tPc still having a firm grip. 10 minutes left, tPc was leading by 66. FS took high-rl, getting the next quad. Then suddenly they had tele and middle as well and the tables were turned. All the tPc players ended up in low-rl/backroom. With 8 minutes left, they were still in the lead with 56. FS take the quad and bring it to low-rl. Carnage ensues. 7 minutes left, tPc still up by 43, loosing ground. Riker and Phaze have bad packetloss and it looks as if tPc are loosing the whole level now. FS taking firm control, spawnfragging away at a high speed. 6 minutes left and the tPc lead has been reduced to 24 frags. FS keep getting the quad and tPc stick to the backroom. FS keep shipping their quads to low-rl and the fragtoll on tPc is high! 4 minutes remaining, tPc up by 4 frags. FS passes them by and keeps going, taking the last quads and holding on to the level until the end. Very nice comeback from FS! tPc were unlucky to have some of their players lag so badly. Unfortunately there isn't much to do when it happens." -Ego === DM3 === FS: 139 - TPC: 63
[[Image:Fs tpc dm3.gif]]
Map pick by Firing Squad.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/2/2b/Infinity_-fs-_vs_tpc_dm3.qwz infinity (FS)]

"DM3 begins with tPc again getting the goodies, both pent and quad. tPc take YA as FS control RA. tPc continues to take quad again and have a cautious lead in the 2:nd minute of the game ... up by 4 frags. They get another quad before FS claims YA and takes one for themselves. The game is very intense as tPc leads by just one frag with 16 minutes to go. FS continue to put pressure on tPc, taking the lead and killing a tPc quad. FS get the pent in the fifth minute and take it to RA. tPc keeps to YA and gets the next quad ... not much comes out of the game though ... FS takes the next and slowly adds to their lead, also claiming YA. 10 minutes to go sees FS in the lead by 19, taking the pent again. Once again tPc has nasty packetloss and Wolverines cable suddenly gives him a nice and steady 350ms. Some router in Stockholm had gone down and Wolv's ping didn't stabilize for a minute and a half or so. FS are now in control and are taking a large lead, killing tPc players all over. tPc obviously not happy with the conditions, not fighting back very hard. FS played well, tPc were unlucky again. Unfortunately this was the only server-suggestion, and Wolv's ping was just bad luck. I hope they gods are with them on the next one." -Ego == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** FS: 344 ** TPC: 207 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
